# Cncf Kbind Reviewer

Review kbind using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Automation &amp; Configuration category. kbind aims to provide better support for service providers and consumers that reside in distinct Kubernetes clusters.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
